title: Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence (AI-2026)
author: Dr. Rajesh Sharma (HOD)
description: Comprehensive curriculum covering linear algebra, multivariate calculus, optimization, deep neural networks, and computer vision.

units.title: Unit 1: Linear Algebra & Matrix Operations
units.description: Foundations of linear equations, matrix multiplication, rank, eigenvalues, and vector spaces.
learning_goals: Solve system of linear equations using matrix inverse

units.title: Unit 2: Calculus, Derivatives & Optimization
units.description: Differential calculus, partial derivatives, gradient vectors, and gradient descent optimization.
learning_goals: Compute partial derivatives of multivariable cost functions
Analyze effect of learning rate alpha on convergence
Identify local minima and saddle points

units.title: Unit 3: Deep Neural Networks & Loss Functions
units.description: Multi-layer perceptrons, non-linear activation functions, cross-entropy loss, and backpropagation.
learning_goals: Derive backpropagation weight updates using chain rule
Compare Binary Cross-Entropy vs Mean Squared Error
Select appropriate activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax)

units.title: Unit 4: Computer Vision & Transformer Architectures
units.description: Convolutional neural networks, feature maps, self-attention mechanisms, and transformer encoders.
learning_goals: Understand spatial convolutions and max pooling operations
Apply pre-trained models for downstream vision and text tasks
